weakness: No account procedure, approvals, or reviews; departing agents keep access up to two weeks; shared administrator password never changed; office-wide file visibility
source: P07 (AC-02 objectives); P01 R-009; P03 G-007, G-008
remediation_plan: Onboarding and offboarding checklist tied to the agent license transfer notice; monthly user reconciliation; agents limited to their own files in SYS-01
milestones: 2026-09-30 checklist in use; 2026-10-31 visibility changed and first monthly reconciliation
resources_required: Office Manager time (1 hour a month)

weakness: Shared global administrator and backup console accept a password alone
remediation_plan: Two named administrator accounts with MFA (Office Manager, MSP); shared account disabled; break-glass account sealed with the Broker-owner; MFA on the backup console
milestones: 2026-09-15 named accounts created; 2026-09-30 shared account disabled and backup console MFA evidenced

weakness: 22 agent mailboxes and the e-signature service have no MFA; legacy protocols bypass MFA
remediation_plan: Agents enroll in authenticator-app MFA (enrollment sessions at the October sales meeting); MFA turned on for SYS-01 and SYS-03 for all users; legacy protocols blocked tenant-wide
milestones: 2026-10-09 enrollment sessions; 2026-10-23 MFA enforced; 2026-10-31 legacy protocols blocked
resources_required: MSP labor (about 3 hours); no license cost

weakness: No alerts on forwarding rules, risky sign-ins, or bulk downloads; 3 mailboxes forwarded all mail to personal webmail
source: P07 test (new finding); P01 R-025, R-001; P03 G-018
remediation_plan: Rules removed (done 2026-08-19); external auto-forwarding blocked; built-in alerts to the Office Manager and the MSP; counsel note on monitoring agent mailboxes added to the agent agreement
milestones: 2026-08-19 rules removed; 2026-10-15 forwarding blocked and alerts on; 2026-12-31 agreement updated
resources_required: MSP labor (about 1 hour); counsel time within the R-016 budget

weakness: No review of sign-in, mailbox, or download logs
remediation_plan: Weekly 15-minute review of alerts and the new-rule report; monthly SYS-01 download report; findings to the Broker-owner at the monthly review; logs kept 1 year
milestones: 2026-10-16 first weekly review; 2026-12-31 one-year log retention
resources_required: Office Manager time (about 1.5 hours a month)

weakness: Agent mailboxes and SYS-01 files not backed up; one password-only login can delete all backups
remediation_plan: Extend SYS-09 to all 29 mailboxes; monthly export of active SYS-01 files to the shared files; backup console MFA (POAM-002)

weakness: Backup never restore-tested; no contingency plan
remediation_plan: MSP restores a sample mailbox, a folder, and the sales escrow ledger; quarterly tests with written results; short contingency plan with the hurricane checklist and backup approver
milestones: 2026-09-30 first restore test; 2026-12-31 contingency plan and second test

weakness: No training after hire; agents untrained; no phishing exercises; near miss not used
remediation_plan: Annual 30-minute training with a wire fraud module for employees and agents; quarterly phishing simulations; the May 2026 near miss used as the first case study
milestones: 2026-11-13 first training at the sales meeting; 2026-12-31 first simulation

weakness: No vendor list, security requirements, or oversight; MSP contract has no security or incident notice terms
remediation_plan: Vendor list with data held and breach contacts; MSP questionnaire with evidence and contract amendment (MFA, 24-hour notice, recovery time, subcontractors); security documents requested from the property management platform and screening provider
milestones: 2026-10-31 vendor list; 2026-12-31 MSP amendment; 2027-03-31 vendor reviews

weakness: Both desktops unencrypted; scanning workstation keeps local scans
remediation_plan: MSP enables full-disk encryption; scans saved straight to the shared files; local scan folder cleared daily
milestones: 2026-10-31 desktops encrypted and local scans deleted

weakness: No written reporting rule; agents do not know whom to call
remediation_plan: POL-03 4.2 reporting rule on a card for every desk and in the agent onboarding packet; covered in training

weakness: DMARC monitor only; look-alike domains delivered
source: P07 test; P01 R-004; P04 finding 1
remediation_plan: MSP reviews DMARC reports and moves the policy to quarantine, then reject; annual look-alike domain check

weakness: Separation of payment duties not documented
remediation_plan: POL-02 B.6 documents initiator and approver roles (approved 2026-09-14); second approval device in the office safe (R-023)
